verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Fastmail letting a team lead assign conversations to teammates or set explicit ownership, which is the core of this story. The only related evidence is a 'Filters & Rules' help article title and community remarks about personal filters. Those are mailbox-filing features, an adjacent capability rather than team routing or assignment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
